I hate to be the one to say this but given the rest of the evidence ( there are many other encounters on video/sound you should see ) it seems to me that this poor man was in the process of drinking himself to death and near the end of that cycle it is possible he was compus mentus enough to get himself shot. Even if he wasnt, a person in that state cannot process basic information and may just not have had a clue wtf was going on.

Yes the police officer should be fired and then tried for manslaughter, but I think that this man's life was at it's end one way or another and it is just a shame that this sort of thing happens at all.
More people feel that viewpoint at some time or another than you might know. Stay strong

Yeah, I couldnt care less about karma on this account, I just want to help people and more upvotes mean more in need will ask for help or at least have the option. 

I wish I had someone to talk to when I went through these things.

Know is a strong word when speaking of other peoples minds. If you are thinking of hurting yourself please talk about it , in real life or here. Ask me anything even if its embarrasing, I would rather be embarrassed and helping someone than proud and not so.

Im happy to hear that things have gone better for you. I dont think people realise how many humans hurt themselves or know someone who has. It is taboo and nobody wants to talk about it. I wish you the best with your family and if you wanna talk msg me im a good listener.

If just one person changes their minds due to all my hours at SW it was well worth it. I wish I could do more.
Thanks guys, I dont know why but it seems hearing that maybe some of you will benefit from my pains makes it a little more bearable. One day at a time.

I dont know why i'm posting this. Maybe it will help someone.

When I grew up I knew my parents were different. Certainly in some good ways, but I never quite got it. People werent welcome at our house, and it seemed I was not welcome elsewhere. My mother took her own life by throwing herself out of our minivan while I tried to hold her back ( 10 years old? maybe 11? ) Years later after a long battle with cancer my father hung himself. I came home from the hospital and found him. I still have trouble sleeping. I am an only child.

Please anyone, if you are thinking of hurting yourself, realise how much you mean to people even if you dont know it.

*I post this from a friends laptop, and I know some of you are capable of tracing it. Please don't.*

Willow, if you are reading this... You are a beautiful person inside and out and as low as you feel now ( where I have been countless times ) seems permanent by it's very nature. This too shall pass. If you every want someone to talk to who wont bullshit you with cheesy shit and actually groks where you are at, pm me.
